document_api_meta.title: Get Shipping Template Availability
document_api_meta.env_desc: get seller's available shipping template and return the reason  why the template is not available，this api is now only available for JP and UK market

request_header_param.name: x-tts-access-token
request_header_param.desc: The seller access_token value from [Get Access Token](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/678e3a3292b0f40314a92d75#Get%20Access%20Token%20API), when user_type = 0. Follow this [guide](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/678e3a344ddec3030b238fa0) to get seller access_token.

request_query_param.name: app_key
request_query_param.desc: Every single app will have a unique key. Please use the specific key assigned to your app.

request_query_param.name: sign
request_query_param.desc: Signature generated by gen algorithm. When you send API requests to TTS, you must sign them so that TTS can identify the senders.

request_query_param.name: timestamp
request_query_param.desc: Unix timestamp GMT (UTC+00:00). This timestamp is used across all API requests. Developers can use this convert to local time.

request_query_param.name: shop_cipher
request_query_param.desc:
Use this property to pass shop information in requesting the API. Failure in passing the correct value when requesting the API for cross-border shops will return incorrect response. 
Get by API [Get Authorization Shop](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/6507ead7b99d5302be949ba9?external_id=6507ead7b99d5302be949ba9)

request_body_param.name: product_attribute
request_body_param.desc: The product's dimensions and weight to use when evaluating shipping template availability.

response_param.name: code
response_param.desc: The success or failure status code returned in API response.

response_param.name: message
response_param.desc: The success or failure messages returned in API response. Reasons of failure will be described in the message.

response_param.name: ^templates
response_param.desc: Shipping templates evaluated for availability for the seller's shop.

response_param.name: ^^template
response_param.desc: Shipping template details, including the template ID, name, fulfillment party, and whether it is the default template.

response_param.name: ^^^template_party
response_param.desc:
1 for shipping by platform template
2 for shipping by seller template

response_param.name: ^^service_unreachable_reason
response_param.desc: Reasons the shipping template is unavailable, grouped by shipping service. This field is omitted when the template is available.

response_param.name: ^^^filter_reason
response_param.desc: Reasons this shipping service is unavailable for the template.

response_param.name: ^^^^filter_type
response_param.desc:
1 for length filter
2 for width filter
3 for height filter
4 for weight filter
9 for service mode filter
11 for service filter

func logistics202510GetShippingTemplateAvailabilityGet() {
    configuration := apis.NewConfiguration()
    configuration.AddAppInfo(appKey, appSecret)
    apiClient := apis.NewAPIClient(configuration)
    request := apiClient.LogisticsV202510API.Logistics202510SellerTemplatesGet(context.Background())
    request = request.XTtsAccessToken("your access token")
    request = request.ContentType("application/json")
    request = request.ShopCipher("your shop cipher")
    logistics202510GetShippingTemplateAvailabilityRequestBody := logistics_v202510.NewLogistics202510GetShippingTemplateAvailabilityRequestBody()
    logistics202510GetShippingTemplateAvailabilityRequestBodyProductAttribute := logistics_v202510.NewLogistics202510GetShippingTemplateAvailabilityRequestBodyProductAttribute()
    logistics202510GetShippingTemplateAvailabilityRequestBodyProductAttributeWeight := logistics_v202510.NewLogistics202510GetShippingTemplateAvailabilityRequestBodyProductAttributeWeight()
    logistics202510GetShippingTemplateAvailabilityRequestBodyProductAttributeWeight.SetWeight("10")
    logistics202510GetShippingTemplateAvailabilityRequestBodyProductAttributeWeight.SetUnit(1)
    logistics202510GetShippingTemplateAvailabilityRequestBodyProductAttribute.SetWeight(*logistics202510GetShippingTemplateAvailabilityRequestBodyProductAttributeWeight)
    logistics202510GetShippingTemplateAvailabilityRequestBodyProductAttributeDimension := logistics_v202510.NewLogistics202510GetShippingTemplateAvailabilityRequestBodyProductAttributeDimension()
    logistics202510GetShippingTemplateAvailabilityRequestBodyProductAttributeDimension.SetLength("10")
    logistics202510GetShippingTemplateAvailabilityRequestBodyProductAttributeDimension.SetWidth("10")
    logistics202510GetShippingTemplateAvailabilityRequestBodyProductAttributeDimension.SetHeight("10")
    logistics202510GetShippingTemplateAvailabilityRequestBodyProductAttributeDimension.SetUnit(1)
    logistics202510GetShippingTemplateAvailabilityRequestBodyProductAttribute.SetDimension(*logistics202510GetShippingTemplateAvailabilityRequestBodyProductAttributeDimension)
    logistics202510GetShippingTemplateAvailabilityRequestBody.SetProductAttribute(*logistics202510GetShippingTemplateAvailabilityRequestBodyProductAttribute)
    request = request.Logistics202510GetShippingTemplateAvailabilityRequestBody(*logistics202510GetShippingTemplateAvailabilityRequestBody)
    resp, httpResp, err := request.Execute()
    if err != nil || httpResp.StatusCode != 200 {
        fmt.Printf("productsRequest err:%v resbody:%s", err, httpResp.Body)
        return
    }
    if resp == nil {
        fmt.Printf("response is nil")
        return
    }
    if resp.GetCode()!= 0 {
        fmt.Printf("response business is error, errorCode:%d errorMessage:%s", resp.GetCode(), resp.GetMessage())
        return
    }
    respDataJson, _ := json.MarshalIndent(resp.GetData(), "", "  ")
    fmt.Println("response data:", string(respDataJson))
    return
}
